rationale: CR-001 resolved: the added start test asserts IN_PROGRESS with conversation link, and the new Stop test exercises the real abort() path with only the DB layer mocked, asserting ABORTED. Tests were read, not executed (Stage 7 owns execution).

business_review.item: Req 1: lookup by conversation_id returns only IN_PROGRESS executions via repository method
Req 2: abort endpoint aborts each matching execution via WorkflowExecutionService
Req 4: workflow abort failure logged, does not fail endpoint or skip INTERRUPTED marking
business_review.notes: try/except in router and per-execution in service

business_review.item: Req 6: fail()/finish() must not turn ABORTED into SUCCEEDED/FAILED
Req 7: Stop with no running workflow behaves as today
business_review.notes: empty lookup is a no-op; tested

business_review.item: AC1: Stop sets running execution to ABORTED
AC2: no further nodes start; execution not back to IN_PROGRESS or SUCCEEDED
AC3: Stop on finished execution leaves status unchanged
AC4: Stop on non-workflow conversation unchanged
AC5: abort raising still returns success and marks INTERRUPTED
AC6: active sub-workflow aborted via existing cascade
business_review.notes: reuses abort() cascade; no cascade-specific test

business_review.item: AC7: regression tests cover start, stop, completed, router test
business_review.notes: no start (IN_PROGRESS creation) test; Stop tests mock abort() so ABORTED not asserted

standards_review.notes: 3 commit subjects in range all match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format
New code is small, typed where needed, placed in the owning workflow execution model/service and the abort router; no documented rule broken. Deferred import is commented with its reason.
Abort endpoint keeps the Ability WRITE check on the conversation before aborting workflow executions; no secrets logged, no untrusted-input parsing added.

finding_status.notes: test_create_workflow_execution_from_chat_is_in_progress_with_conversation and test_stop_marks_in_progress_execution_aborted added; the latter runs the real abort() (sets ABORTED, calls update) and asserts ABORTED.
